lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮਨੀਆਰੁ ਨ ਚੂੜੀਆ ਨਾ ਸੇ ਵੰਗੁੜੀਆਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa maneeaar na chooReeaa naa se va(n)guReeaahaa ||
lines.translation: You don't have the bracelets of gold, nor the good crystal jewelry; you haven't dealt with the true jeweller.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਹ ਕੰਠਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਆ ਜਲਨੁ ਸਿ ਬਾਹੜੀਆਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sah ka(n)th na lageeaa jalan s baahaReeaahaa ||
lines.translation: Those arms, which do not embrace the neck of the Husband Lord, burn in anguish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਹੀਆ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਗਈਆ ਹਉ ਦਾਧੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh saheeaa sahu raavan gaeeaa hau daadhee kai dar jaavaa ||
lines.translation: All my companions have gone to enjoy their Husband Lord; which door should I, the wretched one, go to?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਚਜੀ ਤੈ ਸਹ ਏਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)maalee hau kharee suchajee tai sah ek na bhaavaa ||
lines.translation: O friend, I may look very attractive, but I am not pleasing to my Husband Lord at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਠਿ ਗੁੰਦਾਈਁ ਪਟੀਆ ਭਰੀਐ ਮਾਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maath gu(n)daaee(n) pateeaa bhareeai maag sa(n)dhoore ||
lines.translation: I have woven my hair into lovely braids, and saturated their partings with vermillion;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਈ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਆ ਮਰਉ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: agai gaee na ma(n)neeaa marau visoor visoore ||
lines.translation: but when I go before Him, I am not accepted, and I die, suffering in anguish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਰੋਵੰਦੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਰੁਨਾ ਰੁੰਨੜੇ ਵਣਹੁ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai rova(n)dee sabh jag runaa ru(n)naRe vanahu pa(n)kheroo ||
lines.translation: I weep; the whole world weeps; even the birds of the forest weep with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਨ ਰੁਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik na runaa mere tan kaa birahaa jin hau pirahu vichhoRee ||
lines.translation: The only thing which doesn't weep is my body's sense of separateness, which has separated me from my Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਆਇਆ ਭੀ ਗਇਆ ਮੈ ਜਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: supanai aaiaa bhee gaiaa mai jal bhariaa roi ||
lines.translation: In a dream, He came, and went away again; I cried so many tears.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਤੁਝ ਕਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭੇਜਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aai na sakaa tujh kan piaare bhej na sakaa koi ||
lines.translation: I can't come to You, O my Beloved, and I can't send anyone to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਨੀਦੜੀਏ ਮਤੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aau sabhaagee needaReee mat sahu dekhaa soi ||
lines.translation: Come to me, O blessed sleep - perhaps I will see my Husband Lord again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਜਿ ਆਖੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tai saahib kee baat j aakhai kahu naanak kiaa deejai ||
lines.translation: One who brings me a message from my Lord and Master - says Nanak, what shall I give to Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਸੁ ਵਢੇ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sees vadhe kar baisan deejai vin sir sev kareejai ||
lines.translation: Cutting off my head, I give it to Him to sit upon; without my head, I shall still serve Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kiu na mareejai jeeaRaa na deejai jaa sahu bhaiaa vidaanaa ||1||3||
lines.translation: Why haven't I died? Why hasn't my life just ended? My Husband Lord has become a stranger to me. ||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨਿ ਧੋਤੈ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mailai sabh kichh mailaa tan dhotai man hachhaa na hoi ||
lines.translation: When the mind is filthy, everything is filthy; by washing the body, the mind is not cleaned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ih jagat bharam bhulaaiaa viralaa boojhai koi ||1||
lines.translation: This world is deluded by doubt; how rare are those who understand this. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man mere too eko naam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant the One Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur deeaa mo kau ehu nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has given me this treasure. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧਾ ਕੇ ਆਸਣ ਜੇ ਸਿਖੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidhaa ke aasan je sikhai i(n)dree vas kar kamaai ||
lines.translation: Even if one learns the Yogic postures of the Siddhas, and holds his sexual energy in check,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man kee mail na utarai haumai mail na jaai ||2||
lines.translation: still, the filth of the mind is not removed, and the filth of egotism is not eliminated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is man kau hor sa(n)jam ko naahee vin satigur kee saranaai ||
lines.translation: This mind is not controlled by any other discipline, except the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satagur miliai ulatee bhaee kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||3||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one is transformed beyond description. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਦੋ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak satigur kau milado marai gur kai sabad phir jeevai koi ||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, one who dies upon meeting the True Guru, shall be rejuvenated through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mamataa kee mal utarai ihu man hachhaa hoi ||4||1||
lines.translation: The filth of his attachment and possessiveness shall depart, and his mind shall become pure. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadaree satagur seveeai nadaree sevaa hoi ||
lines.translation: By His Grace, one serves the True Guru; by His Grace, service is performed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nadaree ihu man vas aavai nadaree man niramal hoi ||1||
lines.translation: By His grace, this mind is controlled, and by His Grace, it becomes pure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man chet sachaa soi ||
lines.translation: O my mind, think of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko chetahi taa sukh paavahi phir dookh na moole hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Think of the One Lord, and you shall obtain peace; you shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਮਰਿ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadaree mar kai jeeveeai nadaree sabad vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: By His Grace, one dies while yet alive, and by His Grace, the Word of the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nadaree hukam bujheeai hukame rahai samaai ||2||
lines.translation: By His Grace, one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and by His Command, one merges into the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਸਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jihavaa har ras na chakhio saa jihavaa jal jaau ||
lines.translation: That tongue, which does not savor the sublime essence of the Lord - may that tongue be burned off!

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੇ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: an ras saade lag rahee dukh paaiaa doojai bhaai ||3||
lines.translation: It remains attached to other pleasures, and through the love of duality, it suffers in pain. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa nadar ek hai aape pharak karei ||
lines.translation: The One Lord grants His Grace to all; He Himself makes distinctions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satagur miliai phal paaiaa naam vadaaee dei ||4||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, the fruits are obtained, and one is blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||4||2||
